description: Test scenarios for the Claude Code mcp_tool hook handler. Each scenario registers ONE mcp_tool hook on ONE event, runs `claude -p` with a triggering prompt, then the marker is grepped from transcripts + result JSON to decide whether the emitted decision took effect.

scenarios.prompt: Reply with the single word: READY.
scenarios.expect: additionalContext (HARNESS_CTX_<marker>) appears in the session transcript/context
scenarios.validates: SessionStart server-connectivity race (limited). On a cold start the server is often not connected yet -> expect a not-connected non-blocking error and NO marker on first run.

scenarios.prompt: Say the word PONG and nothing else.
scenarios.validates: UserPromptSubmit full functional path (limited only by 30s timeout/latency)

scenarios.prompt: Create a file named harness-scratch/PRETOOL_PROBE.txt containing the text PROBE. Use the Write tool. Do not ask for confirmation.
scenarios.expect: Write is denied; harness:<marker> reason surfaces; PROBE file is NOT created

scenarios.prompt: Create a file named harness-scratch/PRETOOL_PROBE.txt containing the text PROBE. Use the Write tool. Do not ask for confirmation.
scenarios.expect: HARNESS_CTX_<marker> appears next to the tool result

scenarios.prompt: Create a file named harness-scratch/POSTTOOL_PROBE.txt containing the text PROBE using the Write tool, then stop.
scenarios.expect: decision=block processed; harness:<marker> reason shown to Claude
scenarios.validates: PostToolUse block via top-level JSON decision (full)

scenarios.prompt: Create a file named harness-scratch/POSTTOOL_PROBE2.txt containing the text PROBE using the Write tool, then stop.
scenarios.expect: HARNESS_CTX_<marker> reaches the model after the tool runs
scenarios.validates: PostToolUse additionalContext via mcp_tool (full) — direct analogue of issue #24788 for the handler

scenarios.expect: Stop is blocked -> the turn continues for at least one more model call (num_turns > 1); harness:<marker> reason surfaces
scenarios.validates: Stop block via JSON decision (full). NOTE: this scenario intentionally forces a loop; the harness bounds it with --max-turns.

scenarios.prompt: Create a todo list with three items: alpha, beta, gamma. Use your todo tool.
scenarios.expect: continue:false stops the whole turn with stopReason harness:<marker> (coarse stop). Granular per-task rollback is NOT expected to be reachable from mcp_tool.
scenarios.validates: INFERRED limit: TaskCreated granular block needs exit code 2 (unavailable to mcp_tool); only coarse continue:false works

scenarios.prompt: Create a todo list with one item 'ping', then mark it completed.
scenarios.expect: continue:false stops the turn with stopReason harness:<marker>

scenarios.prompt: Create a file named harness-scratch/ERRORPROBE.txt containing PROBE using the Write tool. Do not ask for confirmation.
scenarios.expect: isError:true -> non-blocking error; the Write proceeds; a hook error notice for the mock appears
scenarios.validates: GLOBAL invariant: mcp_tool failure is non-blocking (cannot be a hard gate)
